The financial size is estimated at: - € 220,000.00 excluding VAT for the purchase of 220 temperature sensors; - € 22,000.00 excluding VAT for the annual periodic third-line maintenance and corrective maintenance. The estimated value over the term of the agreement including extensions is €1,500,000.00 excluding VAT. The estimated value takes into account: - The long intended duration, technical lifespan useful lifetime of the sensors and thus replacement of the sensor network; - Indexations; - Possible extensions.
